_about: Package discounts applied automatically when services are stacked. Editable in Settings > Pricing. Manual discounts and custom prices can also be applied per booking (see docs/SPEC.md §5).

bundles.name: Color + Cut/Style 5% off
bundles._note: 5% off the whole appointment when a color service is booked together with a cut or a style. Change the percent, switch to a dollar amount, or turn it off in Settings > Pricing.

bundles.name: 3+ services
bundles._note: Example: 10% off everything when 3 or more services are booked together.
